roles.name: Mission Biologist
roles.description: I study how humans survive and thrive in space — nutrition, exercise, medical systems, and the science of keeping a crew healthy 240,000 miles from home.
roles.flavor: Crew health specialist. Designs the nutrition systems. Keeps the team mission-ready.

roles.name: Systems Engineer
roles.description: I design and manage the power grids, life support, and environmental systems that keep a lunar colony running. Without me, the lights go out.
roles.flavor: Colony backbone. Powers everything. When systems fail, I fix them.

roles.name: Cyber Architect
roles.description: I build the networks, secure the systems, and make sure nothing takes our colony offline. From comms to navigation — I keep the mission connected.
roles.flavor: Digital defender. Wires the outpost. Keeps Earth in the loop.
